newsitem.title: UK: PowerGen outlines share of windfall tax.
newsitem.headline: PowerGen outlines share of windfall tax.

text.p: British electricity generator PowerGen said on Monday that its share of a one-off tax on excess profits would be around 200 million stg and would be met out of current sources of funds.
Chairman Ed Wallis also told the annual meeting the group's business performance was in line with expectations in the current year.

The one-off tax was introduced by the new centre-left Labour government in its first budget on July 2 and aims to raise a total 5.2 billion stg from the excess profits of utilities privatised under previous Conservative administrations. -- London Newsroom +44171 542 7717
